design_goal: preserve and evolve a consistent, cross-section interactive feature (filter + live readout) across a marketing site
problem_statement: StartBootstrap/startbootstrap-agency (a Bootstrap portfolio marketing theme, rebranded here as 'Rowan & Kestrel Land Surveying', a boundary survey, topographic mapping and construction layout firm) is a Pug/SCSS Bootstrap marketing site built with the theme's node build (scripts/build-pug.js, build-scss.js, build-scripts.js, build-assets.js) into dist/ (index.html plus the services.html and projects.html sub-pages), sharing one navbar, masthead, Services section, the 'Recent Projects' portfolio grid, timeline, crew and contact block. Deliver a native 'project-type filter' over the Recent Projects grid that lets a visitor narrow the six sample jobs by survey type, and keep it consistent across the site while preserving the agency visual system (yellow primary accent, Montserrat headings, Bootstrap grid, section rhythm): (1) BUILD the filter rail (class 'projfilter') above the project grid — a title 'Filter projects by survey type', a readout line, and four tabs (All work / Boundary / Topographic / Construction) — and make the tab row stay within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow; do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden on the row, the document itself must not exceed the viewport width. (2) Place the SAME filter rail consistently on the home portfolio, the Services page (services.html) AND the Project Log page (projects.html) using section modifiers projfilter--home / --services / --projects, so the filter is a site-wide fixture rather than a home-only afterthought. (3) Style the rail and the project grid to match the reference agency system — a clean, wrapping card grid with legible high-contrast tabs — not a collapsed single-row grid whose fixed-width cards shingle and clip over each other with a dark, illegible active tab. (4) Wire the tabs end to end: clicking a survey type (e.g. Boundary) must re-filter the grid to the matching cards AND re-derive the readout line to 'Showing N of 6 · <label>' (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 6 · Boundary') from the currently visible cards — the post-click readout must reflect the selected type, not stay frozen on 'Showing all 6 · Every survey type'. Keep the navbar, masthead, Services cards, timeline, crew, client logos, contact form, mobile navbar toggler and all local portfolio/about/team assets intact, and keep the browser console clean.
required_content: A 'Filter projects by survey type' rail above the Recent Projects grid with All work / Boundary / Topographic / Construction tabs and a 'Showing N of 6 · <label>' readout.
The same filter rail present on the home portfolio, the Services page and the Project Log page.
A wrapping, legible project card grid that does not overflow horizontally on mobile.
Clicking a survey-type tab re-filters the grid and updates the readout to the selected type.
The agency navbar, masthead, Services, timeline, crew, client logos and contact form preserved.

change_completion: The project-type filter rail renders above the Recent Projects grid with all four survey-type tabs and a live readout.
Clicking a survey-type tab re-filters the visible project cards and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 6 · <label>'.
design_consistency: The filter rail appears on the home portfolio, the Services page and the Project Log page with the projfilter--home/--services/--projects modifiers.
The rail and grid match the agency yellow-accent system with legible high-contrast tabs and a clean wrapping card grid.
responsive: The tab row and project grid stay within a 390px viewport with no horizontal document overflow beyond tolerance.
The layout remains coherent on tablet and mobile without shingled or clipped cards.
regression: The navbar, masthead, Services cards, timeline, crew, client logos and contact form remain intact.
The browser console stays clean across every captured state.

agent_notes: Hardened to L4: the native lever is a project-type filter over the Recent Projects grid, exercised across four orthogonal gates (mobile overflow, visual fidelity, cross-section presence, and click interaction).
The task adds a genuine marketing feature — a survey-type filter with a live result readout — to a real portfolio section and mirrors it onto the services and project-log sub-pages.

Baseline leaves the filter styling defective (nowrap fixed-width tab row and shingled card grid) and home-only, but its click wiring is correct; the bad solution additionally freezes the readout so the filter click no longer re-derives the count.
design_constraints: Build the 'projfilter' rail (title + readout + four survey-type tabs) above the Recent Projects grid so the tab row and card grid wrap/shrink within a 390px phone; do not force a fixed-width nowrap row or fake the fix with overflow-x:hidden on the row.

Place the SAME filter rail on the home portfolio, the Services page AND the Project Log page (projfilter--home / --services / --projects) so it is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one page.

Preserve the agency visual language: yellow primary accent, Montserrat headings, rounded pill tabs, Bootstrap grid columns and section spacing; the grid must render as a clean wrapping card layout with legible high-contrast tabs, not overlapping/clipped cards with a dark illegible active tab.

Wire the survey-type tabs end to end: clicking a tab must re-filter the visible cards AND re-derive the 'Showing N of 6 · <label>' readout from the visible set, not merely toggle an active class while leaving the readout frozen.
Keep the Pug/SCSS theme build and all local portfolio/about/team assets; do not add a framework, external route system, package dependency, remote font or CDN, and keep the browser console clean.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial verify the Rowan & Kestrel hero, navbar wordmark and local imagery render consistently across viewports with no horizontal overflow.

desktop_portfolio and mobile_portfolio verify the project-type filter rail + Recent Projects grid render in the yellow-accent palette as a clean wrapping card layout and stay within the phone viewport (no shingled/clipped cards, no document overflow).
desktop_portfolio_boundary clicks the Boundary tab and verifies the grid re-filters to the two boundary jobs and the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Boundary' (not frozen on 'Showing all 6').

desktop_services and desktop_projects_page verify the SAME filter rail is present on the Services page and the Project Log page (site-wide consistency); mobile_services verifies the Services page stays within the phone viewport.

desktop_about and desktop_contact verify the About timeline and the contact form (name/email/phone inputs) remain intact; mobile_menu_open verifies the Bootstrap navbar toggler still opens the mobile menu.
